access_request.requests.title: User Account Access Requests
access_request.request.title: Access Request
access_request.request.approvals.engineN: The Manager → ICT sign-off is handled in the Approval Engine. Approvers act on this request from their Tasks inbox; this page shows the outcome and lets ICT provision the account once approved.
access_request.field.roleIds.help: Comma-separated core Role ids to grant.
access_request.public.hero.subtitle: Apply for a new account or activate an existing one. Your request is reviewed by your manager and the ICT department, then your sign-in credentials are sent to you by email.
access_request.public.process.title: How your request is handled
access_request.public.process.subtitle: A transparent, three-stage approval flow — designed to be quick without cutting corners on security.
access_request.public.step1.title: Submit your details
access_request.public.step1.body: Share your name, organization, and contact details. Everything is kept secure and confidential.
access_request.public.step2.title: Get approvals
access_request.public.step2.body: Your manager and the ICT department review your request and sign off on access.
access_request.public.step3.title: Account ready
access_request.public.step3.body: Your username is approved and a secure set-password link is emailed to you for your first sign-in.
access_request.public.form.title: Account application
access_request.public.form.note: Once approved, your username and a secure set-password link are emailed to you. You'll set your own password from that link before your first sign-in.
access_request.public.form.err.emailInva: Please enter a valid email address.
access_request.public.form.failed: Sorry, your application could not be submitted. Please try again.
access_request.public.form.successBody: Keep this reference to check your status. You'll be notified by email once your account is approved.
access_request.public.footer.copy: Tanzania Social Action Fund (TASAF). MIS access requests.
